items.title: R-universality of the special unitary Lie algebra of a Hermitian form over a quaternion division algebra
items.author: Dave Witte Morris
items.work: A Cohomological Proof that Real Representations of Semisimple Lie Algebras Have Q-Forms
items.source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 034, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.034; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the classification of R-universality for the special unitary Lie algebra of a Hermitian form over a division algebra with an anti-involution (author prop at source lines 566-575): universality holds exactly when the division algebra is an imaginary quadratic extension of Q and either the size is odd or the determinant condition on the Hermitian matrix is satisfied. The proof (source lines 577-609) is a case analysis driven by Tits algebras: it first shows the extension is imaginary using the author's lemma on inner forms (proof lines 578-580), identifies the Tits algebra of the natural representation with the division algebra and forces the division algebra to be the extension itself (proof lines 582-589), and then splits the remaining weights into those moved and those fixed by the star-action, which is where the parity and determinant conditions arise (proof lines 591-609). H2.
